description: This file defines the BuzzDao class, which handles data access operations related to the 'Buzz' feature of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and updating Buzz posts, comments, share interactions, and related entities, as well as query builders for filtering and pagination.

classes.name: BuzzDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Buzz related entities, providing methods to manage, retrieve, and manipulate Buzz posts, comments, shares, likes, photos, links, and related data within the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Buzz feed posts based on provided filter parameters, including related links and counts of shares and likes.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of Buzz feed posts matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPostsQueryBuilder
methods.description: Internal method constructing a query builder for fetching Buzz share posts with applied filters.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Fetches IDs of photos associated with a specific Buzz post.

methods.name: saveBuzzPost
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPost entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzShare entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLink entity representing a Buzz video.

methods.name: saveBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Persists a BuzzPhoto entity.

methods.name: saveBuzzComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: deleteBuzzComment
methods.description: Deletes a specified BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: getBuzzPhotoById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzPhoto entity by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzShareById
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare entity by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Fetches a BuzzComment by its ID, optionally filtering by share ID.

methods.name: getBuzzComments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Buzz comments based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Provides the count of Buzz comments matching filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzCommentsPaginator
methods.description: Internal method for creating a paginator object for Buzz comments.

methods.name: isEmployeeLikedOnComment
methods.description: Checks if an employee has liked a specific comment.

methods.name: getBuzzPostById
methods.description: Fetches a BuzzPost entity by its ID.

methods.name: getBuzzPostTypeByPostId
methods.description: Determines the type of a Buzz post (photo, video, text) based on associated media.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPostPhotos
methods.description: Deletes photos associated with a Buzz post given their IDs.

methods.name: getBuzzLinkByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves the BuzzLink associated with a specific post.

methods.name: deleteBuzzPost
methods.description: Deletes a Buzz post by its ID.

methods.name: deleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Deletes a Buzz share by its ID.

methods.name: adjustLikeAndCommentCountsOnShares
methods.description: Recomputes and updates the like and comment counts on Buzz shares.

methods.name: adjustLikeCountOnComments
methods.description: Recomputes and updates the like count on Buzz comments.

methods.name: getBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzShare associated with a specific post.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesList
methods.description: Retrieves list of Buzz shares for a specific post based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzPostSharesCount
methods.description: Returns count of Buzz shares for a specific post based on filter parameters.
